descriptionChirho: To assign someone to a position, role, or task, or to ordain/establish something in an authoritative arrangement; includes being placed under authority (Matt 8:9), appointing delegates (Acts 15:2), divine appointment to eternal life (Acts 13:48), and the institution of governing authorities (Rom 13:1).
To commit or dedicate oneself to a particular service or task, as in 1 Cor 16:15 where the household of Stephanas devoted themselves to the ministry of the saints.
